manifest.name: Filament
manifest.description: A filament type (Royal Blue PLA) says the filament once: material, colour, diameter, temperatures, whether it needs drying. Each spool picks its type and adds its own size, batch code, how much is left and its state. Each type adds up its spools and kilograms.
manifest.author: Cobblr
manifest.changelog: Filament's description in the bundle list reads plainly, without capitals shouting TYPE and SPOOLS. Earlier: A filament type's fields sit under three headings, Identity, Printing and Spool, and each folds away, so a type's page reads in parts instead of one long list. A field you moved to another section stays where you put it when Filament updates. Earlier: A filament type has ONE colour field. It holds one colour, a blend or several, so a rainbow reads as a rainbow, and the separate colour swatch field is folded into it. Earlier: A scanned spool files as a spool: its type is found or made under it, and a scan never offers the table of types. The spools also know what filament is called (PLA, PETG, 1.75 mm), so a spool is not filed as generic inventory. Earlier: Scanning a spool's QR fills in everything its maker publishes: the exact colour swatch, the UPC, the nozzle and bed temperature ranges, the drying temperature, density, the empty spool weight, and the date the spool was made and its measured length. The UPC is the type's identifier, so scanning the box barcode finds the same type. Earlier: Opens as a catalog of things you own, and stays one: a number typed into one item no longer turns the whole collection into stock tracking with Use one, Used up and a reorder point. Earlier: Types and Spools now sit together in the navbar as one element, a quiet "Filament" stem with "Types │ Spools" links, so the two related tables read as one thing. (0.5.1: scanning a spool's QR find-or-creates its filament TYPE and links the spool automatically, a scan lands in the type→spool model instead of a flat row. 0.5.0: the TYPE defines the whole filament: colour, diameter, nozzle/bed temps and needs-drying live on the type, not re-entered per spool; a SPOOL just picks its type and carries the per-spool facts: size, batch code, remaining, state. Upgrading carries your existing temps + colour up onto the type automatically.)

releases.notes: A dropdown says whether a value you type is remembered as a choice for next time; the open ones (a brand, a vendor, a material) offer what you typed before.

field_defs.name: material
field_defs.help: The plastic type. PLA is the easy default; PETG/ABS for tougher parts.

field_defs.name: color
field_defs.help: One colour, a blend or several: pick them, or type a colour's name.

field_defs.name: diameter
field_defs.help: Filament thickness. 1.75 mm is by far the most common; 2.85 mm for some older/large printers.

field_defs.name: nozzle_temp
field_defs.help: The hot-end temperature that prints this filament cleanly, same for every spool of it.

field_defs.name: bed_temp
field_defs.help: The bed temperature that makes the first layer stick.

field_defs.name: needs_drying
field_defs.help: Whether this filament tends to absorb moisture and should be kept dry / dried before use.

field_defs.name: spool_count
field_defs.help: How many physical spools of this type you own.

field_defs.name: total_remaining
field_defs.help: Total filament remaining across all your spools of this type.

field_defs.name: upc
field_defs.help: The barcode on the spool's box, so a scan of it finds this type.

field_defs.name: nozzle_temp_min
field_defs.help: The coolest nozzle temperature the maker lists.

field_defs.name: nozzle_temp_max
field_defs.help: The hottest nozzle temperature the maker lists.

field_defs.name: bed_temp_min
field_defs.help: The coolest bed temperature the maker lists.

field_defs.name: bed_temp_max
field_defs.help: The hottest bed temperature the maker lists.

field_defs.name: dry_temp
field_defs.help: The highest temperature to dry this filament at.

field_defs.name: density
field_defs.help: Used to turn a weight into a length.

field_defs.name: empty_spool_g
field_defs.help: What the empty spool weighs, to weigh what is left.

field_defs.name: size
field_defs.help: The full-spool size you bought (the label weight), the remaining amount is tracked separately.

field_defs.name: batch_code
field_defs.help: The batch or lot code from the maker's label (e.g. Polar's spool code), for traceability of this exact spool.

field_defs.name: state
field_defs.help: Sealed = unopened; open = in use; empty = used up (keep it for the record or delete it).

field_defs.name: mfg_date
field_defs.help: The date the maker's tag says this spool was made.

field_defs.name: length_m
field_defs.help: The filament length the maker measured on this spool.
